decisions.note: The cited paragraphs (p35-01, p35-02) describe the MUF participatory mapping: 2003 and a 2008 update, 89 buffer-zone communities, 53 local facilitators in 2003 and 345 community representatives in 2008, 8 focus groups per community. Whether this mapping exercise counts as a stakeholder consultation is a matter of interpretation, so the models' disagreement is left open.
